title: Finite set of control keys
statement: The type of keys has the following constructors: entry, lookup, state tail, state home, clear state, to summary, record, to state, successor, halt; table tail and table home, each indexed by a Boolean live flag; state gap and state restore, each indexed by a Boolean live flag; and finish, indexed by a Boolean live flag.
